Sana (People Ops): Heads up — trying to standardize a 1‑page manager cheat for OKR checkins. Want something tiny we can paste into templates and include in the performance cycle kickoff doc. Thoughts?
Miguel M: Love this. Small ask: include a quick way to map work -> objective impact (so ICs can write intent quickly).
Priya K: +1. Also can we add a one‑line rubric for feedback (e.g., evidence, impact, suggested next step)? keeps 1:1s actionable.
Ben R: I made a micro template a while back for my team. sharing below — super short, used it in a 20m manager touchpoint.
Ben R: ```
OKR 1 (Commit): One line goal + measurable metric (target)
Why it matters: 1 sentence
This week: 2 concrete things I'm doing
Ask from manager: what I need from you (blockers, decisions)
Stretch idea: if successful, here's the next lift
```
Liu Z: Can we include a quick confidence check + blockers line? manager can probe and escalate. e.g., Confidence: 3/5 — blockers: infra quota.
Sana (People Ops): Perfect. I'm trying to keep it no more than 6 lines per goal. Also want a manager checklist at top. Draft idea: 
Sana (People Ops): ```
Manager 60s check (pre-1:1): 1) goal alignment clear? 2) metric progress? 3) any cross-team blockers?
During 1:1 (10m per goal): - Ask for 1 highlight, 1 risk, 1 concrete ask - Give focused feedback using Evidence -> Impact -> Next step
Wrap (2m): agree next steps + owner + deadline
```
Priya K: Love the Evidence->Impact->Next step phrasing. Keeps feedback prescriptive. Can we add sample phrasing for managers who struggle with direct feedback?
Ben R: Quick script: "I saw X happen; it led to Y, which mattered because Z. Could you try A next time?" small, concrete.
Miguel M: Also include a line for performance calibration notes for managers to copy into private calibration doc: "Outcome, Signals, Suggested leveling note" — one sentence each.
Sana (People Ops): Good call. I'm going to combine everything into a single paste we can link from the performance cycle page. Draft below — please react with :+1: if good or suggest edits.
Sana (People Ops): ```
ONE-PAGER: OKR 1: manager/IC template
---
Manager pre-check (60s): alignment | metric | cross-team blockers
IC goal line: "Ship X to improve Y by Z% (metric)"
Why: 1 sentence of customer or business impact
This sprint: 2 concrete actions (owners + dates)
Confidence: 1-5 | Blockers: short list
Ask from manager: specific support needed
Feedback rubric (use during 1:1): Evidence -> Impact -> Next step (example script below)
Calibration note (copy into doc): Outcome: short; Signals: 2 bullets; Leveling note: 1 sentence
Example feedback script: "When you did X, I noticed Y. That had Z impact. To improve, try A by next checkpoint."
---
Use it for each OKR or major weekly priority. Keep each goal to 6 lines so the conversation stays focused.
```
Liu Z: This is gold. small ask — add a short line for cross-team dependencies with owner and ETA.
Sana (People Ops): Will add dependency row. Any other blockers to ship?
Miguel M: Maybe one more example for stretch goals phrasing (helps coaches).
Priya K: I'm good. Happy to pilot with my eng team next week and report back.
CoachBot: Tip: copy template into a private doc and pre-fill before 1:1 to increase efficiency.
Sana (People Ops): Thanks all — I'll update and post in the performance cycle kickoff. If anyone wants to test on a mock 1:1, ping me and I'll join. :raised_hands:
